title: 第963章 祖碑也一并打包詹台玄坤要龙凤结合第962章 祖龙尸骸大乘期圆满
content_zh:
“呼~”
良久，林陌方才长长地吐了口浊气。
他目光微垂，看向地上那具已经干瘪了的祖龙尸骸。
“这就榨干了么？也不知是我高估了祖龙尸骸体内剩余的能量，还是我低估了大乘后期到大乘期圆满所需的能量...”
但仔细想来也不奇怪。
这具祖龙尸骸放在这里已不知多少个岁月了，其体内蕴藏的力量定然是在不断流逝的。
如此漫长的岁月过去，还能让他从大乘中期一路突破到大乘期圆满之境，便已经很不错了。
并且也侧面证明了，当年的祖龙的含金量有多高！
“也差不多该出去了，我这次修炼，估摸着不会低于三百年吧，不能让紫紫在外面等急了。”
三百年时间，足够外界发生诸多变化了。
就是不知，祖碑空间的时间流速，是否与外界一致了。
不过，在临走之前，林陌还看上去那具已然干瘪了祖龙尸骸。
虽说其体内的金龙法则之力已经被吸收殆尽，但其骨架及皮囊，仍然具有难以想象的巨大价值。
无论是用来炼丹、炼器亦或是用来给宗门的人设置奖励，都是大陆顶尖的。
于是，林陌将缩水了许多的祖龙尸骸收入储物戒之中，而后随手撕开一道空间通道钻了进去。
与此同时。
祖地的石碑前，柳紫嫣已经在这里等了足足三十年之久。
只不过，三十年时间对于柳紫嫣来说，其实也并不算长。
她猜测林陌也许是在祖碑空间里找到了什么机缘际遇，这才耐心的在此等待，不然的话...
她不保证会做出什么出格的举动。

嗡！
某一刻。
那座沉寂了三十年的石碑，终是有着一道金光绽放而出。
柳紫嫣娇躯一颤，那绽放的金光，随即在她的注视下，化作了一道高大威武的身影。
“夫君？”
感受着林陌身上那股非同寻常的强横气息，即便是以柳紫嫣的见识也不由地一怔：“你的修为...”
“嘿，让师姐久等了。”
林陌嘿嘿一笑，随即将自己此行的经历，言简意赅地跟柳紫嫣说了一遍。
听完之后，柳紫嫣难以置信地瞪大了眼眸，不可思议道：“祖龙的尸骸，竟然藏在太古真龙族的祖碑空间之中？”
“他们可真能藏啊，便是不知摩诃帝俊那老东西，为何放着如此宝藏不动？”
但凡在过去无数个岁月之中有一位太古真龙族的族长来到祖碑空间，并获得祖龙尸骸留下的机缘际遇，涅盘天凤族都不可能做得到与他们几乎平起平坐！
“谁知道呢。”
林陌摆了摆手，轻笑道：“也许，是他没有身怀五爪金龙血脉，所以进不去祖碑空间吧？”
当然，这只是林陌的猜测，具体嘛...
随着摩诃帝俊的陨落，已经没有人来告诉他们确切的答案了。
content_en:
"Huh~"
After a long time, Lin Mo finally let out a long breath.
He lowered his eyes slightly and looked at the shriveled Ancestral Dragon corpse on the ground.
"Is this all drained out? I don't know if I overestimated the energy remaining in the ancestor dragon's corpse, or if I underestimated the energy required from the late Mahayana to the Mahayana period..."
But it’s not surprising if you think about it carefully.
This ancestral dragon corpse has been here for countless years, and the power contained in its body must be constantly passing away.
After such a long period of time, it is already very good that he can still break through from the middle stage of Mahayana to the state of perfection in the Mahayana stage.
And it also proves how valuable the Zulong was back then!
"It's almost time to go out. My cultivation this time will probably be no less than three hundred years. We can't let Zizi wait outside."
Three hundred years is enough time for many changes to occur in the outside world.
I just don’t know if the time flow rate in the ancestral monument space is consistent with the outside world.
However, before leaving, Lin Mo still looked at the shriveled corpse of the ancestral dragon.
Although the power of the Golden Dragon Law in his body has been completely absorbed, his skeleton and skin still have unimaginably huge value.
Whether it is used for refining elixirs, refining weapons, or setting rewards for sect members, they are among the best in the mainland.
So, Lin Mo put the shrunken ancestral dragon corpse into the storage ring, then casually tore open a space passage and got in.
at the same time.
Liu Ziyan has been waiting here for thirty years in front of the stone monument in her ancestral land.
However, thirty years is actually not a long time for Liu Ziyan.
She guessed that Lin Mo might have found some chance encounter in the space of the ancestral monument, so he waited patiently here, otherwise...
She doesn't guarantee that she will do anything outrageous.
Buzz!
at some point.
The stone tablet that had been silent for thirty years finally burst out with a golden light.
Liu Ziyan's delicate body trembled, and the blooming golden light immediately transformed into a tall and mighty figure under her gaze.
"Husband?"
Feeling the unusual and tyrannical aura on Lin Mo's body, even with Liu Ziyan's knowledge, she couldn't help but be startled: "Your cultivation level..."
"Hey, senior sister, I kept you waiting."
Lin Mo chuckled, and then told Liu Ziyan his experience of this trip in a concise and concise manner.
After hearing this, Liu Ziyan's eyes widened in disbelief, and she said in disbelief: "The corpse of the ancestral dragon is actually hidden in the ancestral monument space of the ancient True Dragon Clan?"
"They are really good at hiding it, but I don't know why that old guy Maha Dijun left such a treasure untouched?"
Whenever a patriarch of the Ancient True Dragon Clan came to the Ancestral Monument Space in the past countless years and received the chance encounter left by the Ancestral Dragon Corpse, it would be impossible for the Nirvana Tianfeng Clan to be almost on an equal footing with them!
"Who knows."
Lin Mo waved his hand and chuckled: "Maybe it's because he doesn't have the blood of the five-clawed golden dragon, so he can't enter the ancestral monument space?"
Of course, this is just Lin Mo's guess, what are the specifics...
With the fall of Emperor Mahadeva, no one can tell them the exact answer.
